$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006, FLR-ADR-007): FS_annotation 0.1.0, registry/FS_annotation/spec.md. Applied to the extension's top-level data, extensions.FS_annotation, by a validator that implements FS_annotation and knows it (spec.md 1.2). FS_annotation adds no kind of element and requires no other extension: its data is the house's drawing annotation (dimensions and notes, records in the document's one space of IDs). What an ID names, a level that does not exist and a direction of [0, 0] are checked by the invariants (spec.md 1.3 and 2.1); anchors that name nothing, or cannot be measured, by the lints (spec.md 2.2 and 2.3).
title: FS_annotation 0.1.0
description: Drawing annotation of a house: dimension strings associated with the junctions, wall faces and openings they measure, and notes with leaders, that every exporter and agent reads.

dimensions.description: 2.1: the dimension strings: an ID -> record map; the IDs share the document's one space of IDs.

notes.description: 3.1: the notes: an ID -> record map; the IDs share the document's one space of IDs.

length.description: Core 2.1: a length, an integer number of base units of 1/1280 mm.

point.description: 1.4: a point of the plan, [x, y]: plan coordinates (Core 2.3), each a length.

level.description: 1.3: the level it is drawn on (FS-ANNO-1.3.3: a level of the document).

direction.description: 2.1: the direction its lengths are measured along, [dx, dy], two lengths (FS-ANNO-2.1.1: never [0, 0]).

through.description: 2.1: a point its dimension line passes through: where it is drawn.

anchors.description: 2.2: the features it measures between, in the order it is drawn.

name.description: What it is called, 1-200 characters: "Overall, south".

extras.description: As Core 1.7: data no specification defines.

anchor.title: Anchor
anchor.description: 2.2: one feature a dimension string measures from or to: exactly one of a junction, a wall's line, an opening's centre and a point.

wallAnchor.description: 2.2: a straight wall's left or right face line, or its location line (Core 5.4, 5.5).

openingAnchor.description: 2.2: an opening's centre: the midpoint of its start and end points (Core 7.4, 21.6).

pointAnchor.description: 2.2: a point of the plan, associated with nothing.

level.description: 1.3: the level it is drawn on (FS-ANNO-1.3.3: a level of the document).

text.description: 3.1: what it says, 1-500 characters; a line feed starts a new line.

at.description: 3.1: where its text is drawn: the start of the baseline of its first line.

leader.description: 3.1: the point its leader's arrow points at; absent, no leader.

about.description: 3.1: what it is about: an element, an extension element, a program item, a scene, a view or a dimension string (FS-ANNO-3.1.1).

extras.description: As Core 1.7: data no specification defines.
